newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Min Xin Holdings signs US$12 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Min Xin Holdings signs US$12 mln loan.

text.p: Min Xin Holdings has signed a US$12 million term loan facility, arrangers of the deal said Tuesday.

The two-year loan was arranged by the Singapore branches of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) and the Agricultural Bank of China. In addition to the two arrangers, lender banks include Tat Lee Bank and Korea Leasing.
Min Xin Group will use the proceeds of the loan for working capital and to invest in infrastructure projects in Fujian province.
The group noted that it has agreements to invest in two national highway projects for a total of US$18 million.
Min Xin Holdings is the financial and investment arm of the Fujian provincial government.
